name: b4-bus-science-45
note: A large order on a pre-built bus (iron and copper fed at ~550/min each; 6 spare lanes, sinks past every lane end): red and green science at 45/min each, every intermediate (gears, circuits, inserters, belts) made off the bus. ~16 assemblers, several chains. Met = 40+/min of each pack for 3 samples.

objectives.name: red-green-45
objectives.goal: @{agent} our main bus (bus main) carries iron and copper plates and has spare lanes. Build red and green science for 45 a minute each, making the gears, circuits, inserters and belts they need off the bus too, and put the science packs onto the bus.

score.name: taps
score.lua: local b = storage.layout and storage.layout['bus:main'] local n = 0 if b then for _, j in pairs(b.joins or {}) do if j.kind == 'tap' then n = n + 1 end end end return n
